nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a uniformly convex real normed space, let $(u_n)$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. Then $u_n \to x$ in norm if and only if $f(u_n) \to f(x)$ for every continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{R}$ and $\|u_n\| \to \|x\|$.
nodes.title: Kadec–Klee iff, all-functionals form

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a uniformly convex real normed space, let $(u_n)$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. Then $u_n \to x$ in norm if and only if $u_n \to x$ in the weak topology of $E$ (the topology induced by the continuous linear functionals $E \to \mathbb{R}$) and $\|u_n\| \to \|x\|$.
nodes.title: Kadec–Klee iff, weak-topology form

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a uniformly convex real normed space, let $(u_n)$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $f(u_n) \to f(x)$ for every continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{R}$ and $\|u_n\| \to \|x\|$, then $u_n \to x$ in norm.
nodes.title: Kadec–Klee property, all-functionals form

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a uniformly convex real normed space, let $(u_n)$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $u_n \to x$ in the weak topology of $E$ (the topology induced by the continuous linear functionals $E \to \mathbb{R}$) and $\|u_n\| \to \|x\|$, then $u_n \to x$ in norm.
nodes.title: Kadec–Klee property, weak-topology form

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
